# nanosvg

SVG parser and rasterizer by Mikko Mononen, zlib licence (LICENSE.txt).
From https://github.com/memononen/nanosvg at commit
239e102ec2c691f2902e20ace2ed36ee4a35cfe6 (`src/nanosvg.h`, `src/nanosvgrast.h`),
unchanged.

The Switch port draws its menus' panels with it (port/switch/host/host_ui.c).
